notes:
Summary: Enterprise-grade IDE copilot POC focused on regulated workloads. They require a private/VPC control plane or on-prem installer and strict SSO/SAML + KMS. Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions to VS Code with model/version pinning and auditable commit-level logs.

Key technical requirements (from SE call):
- Workload: IDE copilot + inline completions, PR suggestions, and pre-commit linting; secondary: embeddings for code search.
- Latency: target 20-50ms per token for interactive completion streaming in the IDE; tail p99 < 200ms for small completions.
- Throughput: support ~200 concurrent devs actively generating completions; estimate ~120k tokens/min during peak.
- Model versioning: must pin route-by-project and per-route pinning to model version (e.g., redwood-llama-70b-q4 or approved equivalent). Automated fallback to smaller quantized family for cost or degraded capacity.
- Observability/audit: commit-level audit trail (git SHA + user), per-request retention controls, immutable audit logs for 7 years (cold) and 1 year hot; exportable to SIEM.
- Security: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM for provisioning, AWS KMS/HSM integration, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence required.
- Deployment: prefer VPC-private control plane with egress restrictions; on-prem air-gapped option evaluated for high-risk teams.
- Cost sensitivity: aiming for effective cost <= $0.30 per 1k tokens for active completions; willing to trade small latency degradation for 2-3x lower unit cost on background jobs.

POC notes and timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (ff-2026-02-18-ax-9982). Confirmed security checklist and initial SOW scope.
- 2026-03-02: Deep technical workshop (ff-2026-03-02-ax-10456) with infra and security teams. Agreed on VPC networking constraints and KMS proof-of-concept.
- POC plan: week 0: deliver VPC control plane image + installer; week 1: VS Code extension integration + auth (Okta); week 2: run 2-week parallel eval against internal copilot (measure latency, accuracy, token spend).
- Success criteria: sustained p95 latency < 60ms, fidelity on code completions >= internal baseline, clear audit export process, and legal sign-off on retention/residency.

Sales/contract notes:
- AE feedback: prioritizing Dedicated/Private offering; customer asked for a draft SOW + pricing tiers for 200/500/1000 seats.
- Legal: wants specific data residency clause (US-only) and enumerated SLAs for retention and log immutability.

Direct quotes / snippets: "We cannot expose proprietary code to external LLM endpoints — must be VPC or on-prem." "Need to see token-level billing tied to repo/project."

Next actions (short):
- Maya to deliver updated SOW and price band by 2026-03-12 (missed, follow-up).
- Schedule SOC2 gap call with security on 2026-03-15.
- SE to prepare VS Code stream demo with 50ms simulated latencies and model-pinning UI.

Open blockers: Legal retention language, encryption proof for code snippets when persisted, procurement approval timeline (Q2).
